description: /orrery - deep-dives any codebase with parallel read-only scout agents and generates an interactive, zoomable, embeddable system-design map as one self-contained HTML file: 4 zoom tiers (landscape to key files), file-level GitHub links pinned to an anchor SHA, external systems, and per-node product-context prose. /orrery update refreshes an existing map incrementally. Ships the lockfile-pinned LikeC4 toolchain, the restricted orrery-scout agent, deterministic merge/emit/validate/render scripts, and publish-safety screening (secret quarantine, unconditional HTML escaping, sandboxed-iframe embed guide).
name: orrery
